title: Release a 2.5-inch drive from its pinned service bracket
instruction: Pull the blue compliant side rail outward, tilt the marked drive edge clear of its released pins, slide away from the opposite pins, and lift the drive onto the staging supports. Let the rail return and withdraw both grippers. The assembly is already removed from the computer and disconnected.
context: Computer service technicians flex a removed drive bracket to release its mounting pins before lifting out the drive (Dell OptiPlex 7060 Tower service manual pp23-24). This benchmark isolates that mechanical step after cables and chassis assembly are removed.
setup: Standard YAM station, tabletop z=0.7475 m. Fixed original bracket fixture at (0.24,0,0.7975) m. The prepared drive case is 100 x 69.85 x 6.8 mm, center (0.24,0,0.8039) m. Two pins per side enter real 4.8 mm bores. The +Y side rail has a passive 0-7 mm spring-return joint and a benchmark handling extension. It starts at rest, pins engaged. The disconnected drive is already installed in this bracket; no chassis access or electrical mating is scored. Staging supports center at (0.25,-0.19), top z=0.7725 m. All bracket/pin/bore/compliance/mass/material geometry is benchmark-authored; only the external drive envelope is manufacturer-dimensional. Complete collider and parameter tables are in scene.json and PARAMETERS.md.
scoring: 0.25 during a correctly observed side-rail release of at least 4.5 mm. After release, observed edge tilt and opposite-pin withdrawal, 0.5 for full extraction; another 0.25 for rail return within 0.5 mm and 0.25 for staging within 1.5 mm lateral/0.5 mm vertical/0.025 rad. Full score requires 2 s stability below 8 mm/s and 0.15 rad/s, robot clearance 20 mm; otherwise capped at 0.95. >0.35 mm penetration, fixture movement, invalid frames, joint violations or loss invalidate the trial.
run_limit: 6,500 control actions at 20 Hz (325 simulated seconds)
reset_notes: Seed 0, zero jitter. Restore all assembly poses, drive velocities and rail joint position/velocity to zero. Clear scorer release/tilt/withdrawal histories and controller/recovery state; repeat native probes twice after reset.
fidelity: Dell-grounded one-side bracket release and drive removal only. Samsung 870 EVO external envelope documented; original bracket, larger pin bores, handling extension, masses and spring-return prismatic flexure are approximations. Bench fixture anchors the bracket. Cables/chassis access, electrical mating, production force, flexural stress and exact Dell compatibility are not modeled. Native/expert/Dream/hardware not run.
scores: Native expert: not run; Dream-1: not run. Ideal joint tracking is a synthetic CPU fixture.
